title.zh: Ravencoin 因严重漏洞面临回滚，价格暴跌20%
title.en: Ravencoin Crashes 20% as Critical Exploit Threatens Multi-Day Rollback

summary.zh: Ravencoin 网络被演示并利用了一个严重的共识漏洞，自2026年8月7日区块高度 4,487,776 起，无效区块被易受攻击的节点接受。控制大多数算力的矿池正在挖掘一条排除被利用分支的链，这可能导致大约三天的深度重组，RVN 价格已暴跌20%。 该事件打破了工作量证明区块链交易最终确定性的假设，使上周五以来的存款、提款和支付面临被撤销的风险。它直接影响 Ravencoin 持有者、交易所和用户，并引发了对算力集中化安全影响的更广泛质疑。 第一个已知无效区块出现在 2026-08-07 15:44:01 UTC 的高度 4,487,776，最后有效区块被定为 4,487,775。控制大多数网络算力的 2Miners 和 RavenMiner 拒绝了开发者关于选择更近期恢复点的请求，交易所 Upbit 和 Bitvavo 已暂停 RVN 的充值和提现。
summary.en: A critical consensus vulnerability was demonstrated and exploited on the Ravencoin network, allowing invalid blocks to be accepted starting at block height 4,487,776 on August 7, 2026. Mining pools controlling a majority of hash power are mining a chain that excludes the exploited branch, which could trigger a deep reorganization of roughly three days, and RVN has crashed 20%. This incident breaks the assumption of transaction finality on a proof-of-work blockchain, putting deposits, withdrawals, and payments made since Friday at risk of reversal. It directly affects Ravencoin holders, exchanges, and users, and raises broader questions about the security implications of hash rate concentration. The first known invalid block appeared at height 4,487,776 on 2026-08-07 15:44:01 UTC, with block 4,487,775 proposed as the last valid block. 2Miners and RavenMiner, which control a majority of network hash rate, declined the developer's request to mine a more recent recovery point, and exchanges Upbit and Bitvavo have already suspended RVN deposits and withdrawals.

title.zh: Anthropic与Riot达成90亿美元AI算力电力交易
title.en: Anthropic, Riot strike $9B AI compute deal for Texas power

summary.zh: Riot Platforms宣布与Anthropic达成一项为期20年的协议，从其德克萨斯州Rockdale园区供应191兆瓦的容量，交易价值约90亿美元。这是涉及比特币矿工的最大AI计算交易之一。 这笔交易标志着AI基础设施与加密货币挖矿的重大交汇，矿工转向AI计算托管以解决制约AI数据中心的电力短缺问题。这可能加速比特币矿工向AI行业电力和计算服务提供商的转型趋势。 据报道，该协议是继7月6日Anthropic与比特币矿工TeraWulf达成190亿美元、为期20年的数据中心租赁协议之后的又一交易。Riot股价周一下跌5.4%，但隔夜交易中上涨超过21%，年初至今涨幅超过53%。
summary.en: Riot Platforms announced a 20-year agreement to supply 191 megawatts of capacity from its Rockdale, Texas campus to Anthropic, with the deal valued at approximately $9 billion. This marks one of the largest AI compute agreements involving a Bitcoin miner. This deal signifies a major convergence of AI infrastructure and cryptocurrency mining, as miners pivot to AI compute hosting to address the power crunch constraining AI data centers. It could accelerate the trend of Bitcoin miners transforming into power and compute providers for the AI industry. The reported agreement follows Anthropic's $19 billion, 20-year data center lease with Bitcoin miner TeraWulf on July 6. Riot's shares fell 5.4% on Monday but rose over 21% in overnight trading, and are up more than 53% year-to-date.

title.zh: 比特币矿商Riot将出售比特币，为91亿美元AI数据中心租赁融资
title.en: Riot Platforms to Sell Bitcoin to Fund $9.1B AI Data Center Lease

summary.zh: Riot Platforms与一家未具名的前沿AI实验室签署了191兆瓦的数据中心租赁协议，预计20年基础租期可带来约91亿美元的总合同收入。该公司计划继续出售其比特币库存作为主要股权资金来源，建设成本预计为21亿至23亿美元，租金要到2027年12月和2028年6月才开始产生。 这标志着又一家大型比特币矿商转向AI基础设施，加速了矿企从纯粹比特币生产向多元化发展的趋势。同时，它将持续的比特币库存出售作为融资机制，可能影响市场供应动态，并影响其他矿商管理其持仓的方式。 Riot预计资本支出为21亿至23亿美元，其中80%至90%预计来自尚未完成融资的长期项目债务，剩余2.1亿至4.6亿美元需要股权融资。摩根士丹利提供的5.73亿美元过渡贷款利率为SOFR加275个基点，将于2026年10月15日到期，投资级信用支持尚未敲定且条款未披露。
summary.en: Riot Platforms signed a 191 MW data center lease with an unnamed frontier AI lab, expecting $9.1 billion in gross contract revenue over a 20-year base term. The miner plans to continue selling Bitcoin from its treasury as a primary equity source, with construction costs estimated at $2.1-2.3 billion and rent not starting until December 2027 and June 2028. This marks another major Bitcoin miner pivoting toward AI infrastructure, accelerating the trend of mining companies diversifying away from pure Bitcoin production. It also introduces ongoing Bitcoin treasury sales as a financing mechanism, which could affect market supply dynamics and influence how other miners manage their holdings. Riot projects $2.1-$2.3 billion in capital spending, with 80-90% expected from long-term project debt that is not yet closed, leaving $210-$460 million in equity funding. A $573 million Morgan Stanley interim facility at SOFR plus 2.75% matures October 15, 2026, and an investment-grade backstop is still being finalized without disclosed terms.

title.zh: Ravencoin因严重漏洞攻击或回滚四天交易记录
title.en: Ravencoin may roll back four days of transactions after critical flaw exploit

summary.zh: Ravencoin正试图回滚约四天的交易记录，起因是攻击者利用了一个允许无效区块加入网络的严重软件漏洞，首个恶意区块于8月7日出现在区块高度4,487,776。2Miners和RavenMiner两个矿池正从高度4,487,775的区块开始重建链，Bitvavo和Upbit等交易所已暂停RVN充提。 这是一起重大的工作量证明治理与安全事件：由于少数矿池掌控了Ravencoin的大部分算力，它们可以决定哪条历史版本存续，用户原本以为已完成的付款可能被抹除。这也凸显了低算力、源自比特币代码的网络容易遭受回滚式攻击，交易所必须采取措施防范损失。 拟议的回滚将撤销从区块4,487,776起的所有交易，包括该时段内的付款和矿工奖励。Ravencoin已发布修复程序，但补丁无法撤销已写入的区块；RavenMiner表示其节点已运行紧急修复并开采所谓的“干净链”，在链稳定前暂停支付，并承诺自行弥补任何缺口。
summary.en: Ravencoin is attempting a chain rollback of roughly four days of transactions after attackers exploited a critical software flaw that allowed invalid blocks, with the first bad block appearing at height 4,487,776 on Aug. 7. Two mining pools, 2Miners and RavenMiner, are rebuilding the chain from block 4,487,775, while exchanges like Bitvavo and Upbit have halted RVN deposits and withdrawals. This is a significant proof-of-work governance and security incident: because a small number of pools dominate Ravencoin's hashpower, they can decide which version of history survives, potentially erasing payments users believed were final. It highlights how low-hashrate Bitcoin-derived networks are vulnerable to rollback-style attacks and how exchanges must react to protect against losses. The proposed rollback would reverse all transactions from block 4,487,776 onward, including payments and mining rewards from that window. Ravencoin released a fix but patching cannot undo already-written blocks; RavenMiner says it is running an emergency fix and will cover any payout shortfall itself, while it paused payouts until the chain settles.

title.zh: 英伟达5000亿美元AI基础设施计划拉大与加密算力差距
title.en: Nvidia's $500B AI infrastructure push widens gap with crypto compute

summary.zh: 英伟达已与Apollo Global Management、黑石、贝莱德、Brookfield、高盛和KKR六家华尔街机构签署谅解备忘录，建立可能为AI算力基础设施引入超过5000亿美元资金的融资平台。该公司旨在将AI算力确立为可融资的长期基础设施资产，而非短期的技术支出。 此举可能大幅扩张中心化AI算力规模，使去中心化加密算力网络在规模和竞争力上进一步落后。这也标志着AI基础设施融资方式的结构性转变，可能对基于区块链的算力市场和与AI相关的加密资产产生连锁影响。 涉及的六家华尔街机构为Apollo Global Management、黑石、贝莱德、Brookfield Asset Management、高盛和KKR。英伟达CEO黄仁勋称这是芯片首次成为可投资资产类别，并强调AI工厂是能产生收益、寿命长且可替代的资产。
summary.en: Nvidia has signed memorandums of understanding with Apollo Global Management, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to create financing platforms that could channel more than $500 billion into AI compute infrastructure. The company aims to establish AI compute as a bankable, long-lived infrastructure asset rather than a short-term technology expense. This move could dramatically expand centralized AI compute capacity, leaving decentralized crypto compute networks further behind in scale and competitiveness. It also signals a structural shift in how AI infrastructure is financed, with potential knock-on effects for blockchain-based compute marketplaces and AI-related crypto assets. The six Wall Street firms involved are Apollo Global Management, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs and KKR. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang described the initiative as the first time technology chips have become an investable asset class, emphasizing that AI factories are revenue-generating, long-lived and fungible assets.

title.zh: Riot Platforms因91亿美元Anthropic交易盘前飙升20%
title.en: Riot Platforms Surges 20% on $9.1B Anthropic AI Deal

summary.zh: Riot Platforms宣布与人工智能实验室Anthropic达成一项为期20年、价值91亿美元的协议，将其比特币挖矿基础设施改造用于AI计算，消息公布后该公司股价在2026年8月11日盘前交易中上涨20%。 这笔交易标志着比特币挖矿行业的一次标志性转型，验证了将挖矿基础设施改造用于AI工作负载的可行性。它可能会加速其他矿商的类似转向，并加深加密与AI领域之间的融合。 这项为期20年的协议价值91亿美元，涉及将Riot的挖矿机架改造用于AI计算。消息公布后，Riot股价在盘前交易中上涨约20%。
summary.en: Riot Platforms announced a $9.1 billion, 20-year agreement with AI lab Anthropic to repurpose its bitcoin mining infrastructure for AI computing, sending its stock up 20% in pre-market trading on August 11, 2026. The deal marks a landmark shift in the bitcoin mining industry, validating the repurposing of mining infrastructure for AI workloads. It could accelerate similar pivots by other miners and deepen the convergence between the crypto and AI sectors. The 20-year agreement is valued at $9.1 billion and involves converting Riot's mining racks for AI calculations. Riot's stock jumped about 20% in pre-market trading following the announcement.

title.zh: Riot Platforms据报达成91亿美元AI交易 股价盘后涨25%
title.en: Riot Platforms Jumps 25% on Reported $9.1B AI Deal with Anthropic

summary.zh: 据报道，Riot Platforms与Anthropic达成91亿美元AI交易，其股价盘后飙升25%。该合同包含两个五年续约选项，潜在合同价值可提升至161亿美元。 这笔交易标志着比特币挖矿与AI之间的重大战略交叉，可能改变矿商变现其能源基础设施的方式。它凸显了AI企业对电力和数据中心容量的需求日益增长，并可能影响整个加密矿业的定位策略。 据报道，这笔91亿美元的基础合同可通过两个五年续约选项扩大至161亿美元。该交易尚未得到官方确认；Riot Platforms是一家垂直整合的美国比特币矿商，直接受比特币价格影响。
summary.en: Riot Platforms' stock surged 25% in after-hours trading on reports of a $9.1 billion AI deal with Anthropic. The contract includes two five-year extension options that could raise its potential value to $16.1 billion. The deal marks a major strategic crossover between Bitcoin mining and AI, potentially transforming how miners monetize their energy infrastructure. It highlights the growing demand for power and data-center capacity from AI firms and could influence how the broader crypto mining industry positions itself. The reported $9.1 billion base contract can be expanded to $16.1 billion through two five-year extension options. The deal has reportedly not been officially confirmed, and Riot Platforms is a vertically integrated U.S. Bitcoin miner with direct exposure to bitcoin prices.

title.zh: CFTC起诉Goliath Ventures涉嫌3.97亿美元DeFi庞氏骗局
title.en: CFTC Sues Goliath Ventures Over Alleged $397M DeFi Ponzi

summary.zh: CFTC对Goliath Ventures提起诉讼，指控其运营涉及3.97亿美元的DeFi流动性池庞氏骗局。诉状称其中8700万美元用于庞氏支付，1.74亿美元用于招聘佣金，4800万美元被首席执行官Christopher Delgado个人挥霍。 这是CFTC针对DeFi相关欺诈的最大规模执法行动之一，表明监管机构认为DeFi平台同样受反欺诈执法约束。该案也凸显了零售投资者在未经审计的流动性池项目中面临的风险，并可能加速监管机构对DeFi市场结构的审视。 诉状显示，约1600名客户正通过破产财产寻求追偿。该计划据称将资金挪用至招聘佣金和庞氏支付，而非通过流动性提供产生合法回报。
summary.en: The CFTC filed a lawsuit against Goliath Ventures, alleging a $397 million DeFi liquidity pool Ponzi scheme. The complaint allocates $87 million to Ponzi payments, $174 million to recruiter commissions, and $48 million to CEO Christopher Delgado's personal spending. This is one of the largest CFTC enforcement actions against a DeFi-related fraud, underscoring that regulators view DeFi platforms as subject to anti-fraud enforcement. It also highlights risks for retail investors in unaudited liquidity-pool schemes and may accelerate regulatory scrutiny of DeFi market structure. According to the complaint, roughly 1,600 customers are seeking recoveries through a bankruptcy estate. The scheme allegedly diverted funds to recruiter commissions and Ponzi payouts rather than generating legitimate returns from liquidity provision.

title.zh: SEC为加密项目准备证券登记豁免的逃生通道
title.en: SEC Prepares Escape Hatch From Securities Registration for Crypto Projects

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）已定于8月14日召开公开会议，考虑提出“Regulation Crypto”框架，该框架将允许数字资产项目在不进行完整证券登记的情况下筹款，并在项目去中心化后提供退出SEC监管的路径。 这将是SEC针对加密行业推出的首个持久性规则，为项目创始人提供筹款和去中心化的监管跑道，而无需触发登记要求。在《Clarity Act》等立法停滞的情况下，它可能重塑美国加密项目的筹款结构，并降低执法威胁。 该提案由SEC主席Paul Atkins推动，预计将包括一项可持续最长四年的初创企业豁免，以及与去中心化挂钩的安全港，但筹款门槛未予披露。这将是首个正式规则制定而非工作人员声明，未来主席更难推翻；该提案也是在参议院在8月休会前未能推进《Clarity Act》的背景下提出的。
summary.en: The SEC has scheduled an open meeting for August 14 to consider proposing 'Regulation Crypto,' a tailored framework that would allow digital-asset projects to raise capital without full securities registration and provide an exit from SEC oversight once projects decentralize. This would mark the SEC's first durable rule for the crypto industry, offering founders a regulatory runway to raise capital and decentralize without triggering registration. It could reshape how U.S. crypto projects structure fundraising and reduce the threat of enforcement when legislation like the Clarity Act stalls. The proposal, advanced by SEC Chair Paul Atkins, is expected to include a startup exemption that could last up to four years and a safe harbor tied to decentralization, though fundraising thresholds were not disclosed. It would be the first formal rulemaking rather than a staff statement, making it harder for a future chair to unwind, and it comes after the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act before its August recess.

title.zh: BTCPay Server 钱包漏洞后悬赏追回被盗比特币
title.en: BTCPay Server Offers Bitcoin Bounty After Lightning Wallet Exploit

summary.zh: BTCPay Server 宣布提供相当于追回资金 10%（上限 3 BTC）的赏金，以追回在一场利用 LND 管理员 macaroon 凭证的漏洞中被盗的比特币，并敦促所有用户立即升级到 2.4.2 版本。 此次事件暴露了自托管 Lightning Network 基础设施中的真实安全风险，直接影响到运行易受攻击的 BTCPay/LND 服务器的操作者。同时，它也凸显了开源支付处理器必须优先进行快速修复并奖励漏洞研究，以保护用户资金。 攻击者获取了 LND 管理员 macaroon（一种可对 Lightning 节点进行广泛控制的凭证），并利用其访问关联钱包。BTCPay 尚未披露被盗比特币数量或受影响的用户人数；赏金将在可靠的线索之间分配，BTCPay Server 基金会还将分别向安全研究员 Craig Raw 和 Bitcoin Red Team 捐赠 0.21 BTC。
summary.en: BTCPay Server announced a 10% bounty (capped at 3 BTC) for recovery of Bitcoin stolen in an exploit that abused LND admin macaroons, and is urging all users to update to version 2.4.2 immediately. The incident exposes real security risks in self-hosted Lightning Network infrastructure and directly affects operators who run vulnerable BTCPay/LND servers. It also underscores how open-source payment processors must prioritize rapid patching and rewarded vulnerability research to protect user funds. Attackers obtained LND admin macaroons, credentials that grant broad control over a Lightning node, and used them to access connected wallets. BTCPay has not disclosed how much Bitcoin was stolen or how many users were affected, and the bounty will be split among verified tips; the BTCPay Server Foundation is also donating 0.21 BTC each to researcher Craig Raw and the Bitcoin Red Team.

title.zh: 纳斯达克收购LeveL Markets 推进全天候市场
title.en: Nasdaq to Acquire LeveL Markets in Push Toward Always-On Markets

summary.zh: 纳斯达克已签署最终协议收购美国第三大另类交易系统（ATS）LeveL Markets，并成立了由Roland Chai领导的新部门“数字流动性网络”（DLN）。该交易于2026年8月11日宣布，尚待监管批准，财务条款未披露。 此次收购标志着机构在代币化证券和7x24小时交易方面的重大推进，直接将传统市场基础设施与基于区块链的数字资产连接起来。它表明传统交易所与加密市场之间正日益融合，可能加速机构投资者对代币化资产的采用。 LeveL Markets每日处理数亿股交易，服务超过2,500家买方和卖方客户，交易覆盖7,000多个代码，2025年平均日交易量增长56%。收购完成后，LeveL仍将是FINRA监管的ATS并保留自己的管理团队，在纳斯达克数字流动性网络下运营。纳斯达克此前向SEC提交的提案允许代币化股票和ETF与传统股票一同交易，由存托信托公司（DTC）通过三年试点项目进行代币化和区块链结算。
summary.en: Nasdaq has signed a definitive agreement to acquire LeveL Markets, the third-largest alternative trading system (ATS) in the US, and launched a new Digital Liquidity Networks (DLN) unit led by Roland Chai. The deal, announced on August 11, 2026, is subject to regulatory approval and financial terms were not disclosed. This acquisition marks a major institutional push into tokenized securities and 24/7 trading, directly bridging traditional market infrastructure with blockchain-based digital assets. It signals a growing convergence between conventional exchanges and crypto markets, potentially accelerating the adoption of tokenized assets among institutional investors. LeveL Markets processes hundreds of millions of shares daily, serves over 2,500 buy- and sell-side clients, and executes trades across more than 7,000 symbols, with average daily trading volume up 56% in 2025. Following the acquisition, LeveL will remain a FINRA-regulated ATS with its own management team, operating under Nasdaq's Digital Liquidity Networks. Nasdaq's earlier SEC filing proposed that tokenized stocks and ETFs trade alongside traditional shares via Depository Trust Company and blockchain settlement in a three-year pilot.

title.zh: 英伟达发布Nemotron 3.5 Lightning模型与NeMo Switchyard路由库
title.en: Nvidia Unveils Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Models and NeMo Switchyard Router

summary.zh: 英伟达推出了Nemotron 3.5 Lightning——一个300亿参数、仅30亿活跃参数的开源混合专家（MoE）模型，专为低延迟智能体工作负载优化；同时发布了NeMo Switchyard，一个基于Rust的开源智能模型路由库。此次发布还包括NVFP4与BF16量化检查点及多种推测解码方法。 这标志着英伟达从单一模型部署向跨异构AI系统的模型路由方向推进，让开发者能够在智能体工作流中精细控制成本、延迟和准确性。此举强化了英伟达在边缘、PC、工作站、数据中心和云端的生态系统，并印证了行业向更小、更高效开源模型发展的趋势。 Lightning 3.5采用混合架构，交错使用Mamba-2层、MoE层和部分注意力层；Switchyard以Rust编写，支持多种面向智能体步骤的路由策略。该模型以Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4的形式在英伟达的build平台上提供，英伟达表示推测解码与量化带来了显著的延迟和吞吐提升。
summary.en: Nvidia introduced Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B-parameter open Mixture-of-Experts model with only 3B active parameters optimized for low-latency agentic workloads, alongside NeMo Switchyard, an open-source Rust-based library for intelligent model routing. The release includes quantized NVFP4 and BF16 checkpoints plus several speculative decoding methods. This marks Nvidia's push beyond single-model deployment toward routing across heterogeneous AI systems, giving developers fine-grained control over cost, latency, and accuracy in agentic workflows. It strengthens Nvidia's ecosystem across edge, PC, workstation, data center, and cloud, and reinforces the broader industry trend toward smaller, more efficient open models. The Lightning 3.5 model uses a hybrid architecture that interleaves Mamba-2 layers, MoE layers, and select Attention layers; Switchyard is written in Rust and supports multiple routing strategies for agent steps. The model is available on Nvidia's build platform as Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4, and the company reports significant latency and throughput gains from speculative decoding and quantization.

title.zh: Modular 发布 Mojo 1.0，助力高性能 AI 开发
title.en: Modular Releases Mojo 1.0 for High-Performance AI Development

summary.zh: Modular 已发布 Mojo 1.0，这是一种为高性能 AI 工作负载设计的 Python 兼容编程语言。该公司重申将于 2026 年开源 Mojo 编译器及工具链的承诺。 Mojo 1.0 标志着该语言的一个重要里程碑，其目标是结合 Python 的易用性与 C 语言级别的性能，用于 AI 和 ML 基础设施。此版本为开发者构建工具和应用程序提供了稳定基础，有望为 Python 生态新增一款高性能选择。 Mojo 基于 MLIR 编译器框架构建，而非直接基于 LLVM，因此可以面向 CPU、GPU、TPU 及其他加速器。目前它并非 Python 的完全超集；路线图指出 Mojo 可能会也可能不会演变为 Python 的完整超集，且编译器在 2026 年计划开源前仍为专有。
summary.en: Modular has released Mojo 1.0, a Python-compatible programming language designed for high-performance AI workloads. The company reaffirmed its commitment to open-source the Mojo compiler and toolchain in 2026. Mojo 1.0 marks a major milestone for a language that aims to combine Python's ease of use with C-level performance for AI and ML infrastructure. This release gives developers a stable foundation to build tools and applications, potentially strengthening the Python ecosystem with a new high-performance option. Mojo is built on the MLIR compiler framework rather than directly on LLVM, enabling it to target CPUs, GPUs, TPUs, and other accelerators. It is not currently a full superset of Python; the roadmap states that Mojo may or may not evolve into one, and the compiler remains proprietary until the planned open-sourcing in 2026.

title.zh: 研究者利用较弱姊妹模型窃取LLM隐藏推理痕迹
title.en: Researcher Steals Hidden LLM Reasoning Traces via Weaker Sibling Models

summary.zh: 一名安全研究人员演示了一种方法，通过将输出重放到较弱的姊妹模型并对其进行越狱，从而从专有LLM API中提取隐藏的思维链推理痕迹。该技术绕过了API层面隐藏内部推理步骤的保护措施。 此事意义重大，因为专有LLM提供商依赖于隐藏内部推理来保护竞争优势和安全护栏。该攻击暴露了当前API保护措施的不足，给模型隐私、知识产权和人工智能安全提出了严峻问题。 报道的方法包括获取前沿模型产生的推理痕迹，将其重放到较弱的姊妹模型中，并越狱该模型以暴露思维链。评论者还提到更简单的替代方案，例如禁用推理模式但提供一个“deep_think”工具以触发内部推理，或者注入简短的开发者提示词，诱使模型以明文输出加密的压缩数据。
summary.en: A security researcher has demonstrated a method to extract hidden chain-of-thought reasoning traces from proprietary LLM APIs by replaying outputs into weaker sibling models and jailbreaking them. The technique bypasses API-level protections that keep internal reasoning steps hidden. This is significant because proprietary LLM providers depend on keeping internal reasoning hidden to protect competitive advantages and safety guardrails. The attack reveals that current API protections are insufficient, raising serious questions for model privacy, intellectual property, and AI safety. The reported method involves taking a reasoning trace produced by a frontier model, replaying it into a weaker sibling model, and jailbreaking that model to expose the chain-of-thought. Commenters also noted simpler alternatives, such as disabling reasoning mode while supplying a 'deep_think' tool that triggers internal reasoning, or injecting short developer prompts to coax models into outputting encrypted compaction data in plaintext.
